series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: "The Peruvian iNDC envisages a reduction of emissions equivalent to 30% in relation to the Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions of the projected Business as Usual scenario (BaU) in 2030. The Peruvian State considers that a 20% reduction will be implemented through domestic investment and expenses, from public and private resources (non-conditional proposal), and the remaining 10% is subject to the availability of international financing [1] and the existence of favorable conditions (conditional proposal)." [1] It should be noted that Peru will not assume conditional commitments that might result in public debt. The INDC also includes a section on Adaptation.
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 20% (unconditional) to 30% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario
ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

ndc_document.$reason: no sentence in this document states an economy-wide percentage reduction against a base year or a business-as-usual projection.
ndc_document.$note: Read by DS-06-NDC from the First NDC (archived) as mirrored by openclimatedata; unfccc.int itself refuses this engine's requests. Nothing was accepted from this document.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is Peru’s Updated Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0), filed 2025-11-06. 50 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (4). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 151.1 MtCO₂e, DS-02 126.4 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 48.3 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 20% (unconditional) to 30% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.22°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.67°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
